implementation: Futurex Cryptographic Module IID Entropy Source
description: The cryptographic module, herein referred to as the GSP4000 HSM or simply GSP4000, is a multi-chip embedded cryptographic module that encompasses a set of hardware and firmware components which provide a method for strong cryptographic data integrity and confidentiality both in storage and in transit. The GSP4000 HSM is assembled from production quality components.

oes.name: GSP4000 Hardware Security Module using FxOS version 7 on NXP Layerscape LX2162RE82029B
